pages.text: Final pages. Every computation the universe will ever perform, converging on a single point at the end of time: the $(item)Omega Point$(). It is the last thing you can make.

Frank Tipler's 1994 idea: a collapsing universe in which computation speeds up without limit, so infinite thought fits before the end. Cosmology has since argued against it. Mine exists anyway - and a Zero-Point Extractor will happily run on it for ten hours.
The final state of all computation. It already knows how this ends.$(br2)Made in $(item)Omnilex Engine$().
